FIRST FLIGHT

A crow’s-eye view of Chelsea.

Follow a prepared street route through real Google 3D imagery. Pause to explore, or select a business to inspect available details.

The crow is an articulated 3D model inside the city, with flapping wings, banking turns and a following camera. It flies a prepared Chelsea route with gentle swerves. Pause and drag to view it from another angle. Building collision avoidance is not simulated.

Place information is supplied by Google. Demo access may limit available fields; photos and reviews are not requested. Imagery can be dated and less detailed close to buildings.
